name: ListenBrainz and Last.fm
description: Scrobbles what you play to ListenBrainz and Last.fm, and keeps your ListenBrainz Weekly Jams, Weekly Exploration and Daily Jams and your Last.fm loved tracks as Valence playlists.

settings.label: Last.fm API key
settings.help: Only Last.fm needs a key, from an API account at last.fm/api/account/create. ListenBrainz needs nothing here: each person connects it from their account.

settings.label: Request missing albums
settings.help: Requests the albums of songs in kept playlists that aren't in the library. Each person's request permissions and approval rules still apply.
